meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 12 — Digital economy measurement and digital transformation strategy densification.

candidates.title: Digital economy value-added and share of GDP
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / National Statistics Office
candidates.description: Official measurement of the digital economy’s contribution to GDP. In 2025 the digital economy reached an estimated 14.02 % of GDP (approximately USD 72 billion), up substantially from earlier in the decade. Distinguishes core digital sectors from the digitalisation of other industries.
candidates.notes: Core digital-economy statistical product. High-centrality modernisation node.

candidates.title: E-commerce and digital trade component of the digital economy
candidates.description: E-commerce and digitally enabled wholesale/retail activity as a measurable component of the digital economy. Accounts for a significant share of digital-economy value added and generates rising tax revenues.
candidates.notes: E-commerce densification within the digital-economy cluster.

candidates.title: National Digital Transformation Strategy framing
candidates.description: Official National Digital Transformation Strategy (including the 2026–2030 strategy with vision to 2045). Sets targets for digital government, digital economy (ambitious share of GDP) and digital society, and organises policy action across ministries.
candidates.notes: High-level policy frame for the digital agenda.

candidates.title: Vietnam digital-economy densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO and digital-strategy sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding digital-economy value-added and GDP share, e-commerce component, and National Digital Transformation Strategy framing into a coherent digital-modernisation layer.
